inputs.base_revenue_note: FY26 CASH gold sales (123,096oz x A$6,241/oz), not the A$711.361m reported revenue. Reported revenue is after a A$58.0m NON-CASH hedge-accounting deduction (amortisation of the 2024/2025 forward-closure losses parked in the hedge reserve; A$40.6m net of tax remains and unwinds through FY27). The margin anchor is underlying EBITDA A$483.6m / A$769.3m = 62.9%. Reported FY27 revenue will print up to ~A$58m below the model's cash revenue for this reason only.
inputs.share_count_basis: 456,787,789 ordinary shares on issue at 30 June 2026 (FY26 AR note 23) plus ~1.7m dilutive performance rights and the 688,400 unexercised Warriedar options at A$5.275 (DEPS 447.7m vs BEPS 446.0m weighted average shows ~1.7m dilution). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. Non-SBC issuance in FY25/FY26 (A$200m placement, 17.7m hedge-closure shares, 23.8m Warriedar scrip) is already in the 456.8m count; none is assumed forward -- MGGP is fully funded from cash and KGP cash flow per the PFS (min cash balance A$474m at A$5,500 gold).
inputs.sbc_source: FY26 AR cash flow reconciliation, 'Share-based payment expense' A$8,069k (Extracted/CMM.AX_Annual_FY2026.txt:4904); equity-award taxes nil (rights settle gross, no net-share withholding disclosed)
inputs.wacc_rationale: AUD flows discounted at an AUD-built rate: 10y ACGB ~4.3% + 5.5% ERP x beta ~0.95 for an unhedged, ungeared two-asset gold producer = ~9.5% cost of equity; no debt so WACC = CoE. ONE rate across all three scenarios -- gold-price cyclicality, MGGP execution and permitting risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the discount rate (owner-fcf.md 7f).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: full FY26 lease cash (A$10.737m principal in financing + A$1.755m interest in operating = A$12.49m, 1.6% of cash revenue) charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (A$20.3m, the only 'debt') EXCLUDED from net debt so total_debt = 0. D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing row 2: cyclical operating company + section 7). The cyclicality is handled as gold-PRICE scenarios in the flows: base reverts from ~A$6,130/oz spot (US$4,358 x 1/0.7112 on 2026-09-22) to A$4,800/oz by FY30 and holds nominal; bull holds A$6,200; bear reverts to A$3,800 (5-year average territory). PRODUCTION follows the company's own Range 500 outlook chart (27-Jul-2026): KGP 145k->150koz post-KEP (commissioned Q1 FY27), MGGP first gold Q3 FY28 ramping 70/180/230/260koz FY28-FY31 (PFS 27-Jul-2026: 260kozpa steady state yrs 3-6, 190koz LOM average, 19.25y life, AISC A$1,870/oz LOM, A$345m plant + A$129m pre-production mining + A$59m yr-1 UG capital). Base haircuts the ramp (60k/170k/225k/255k) for slippage; bear delays MGGP a year and lifts capex 25%; bull adds Golden Range Stage 2 (90koz from FY31) which is EXCLUDED from base -- PFS/FID only in CY27. COSTS: EBITDA-basis cash cost per oz for KGP anchored at the FY26 actual A$2,321/oz (cash revenue less underlying EBITDA, per oz sold; sits ~A$690/oz above the A$1,629 AISC because cost of sales carries stripping/inventory movements AISC defers) and lifted ~10% for the FY27 AISC guidance step-up to A$1,900-2,100/oz, then +2%/yr; MGGP at ~PFS AISC by year. EBITDA margin paths are the arithmetic result of ounces x price minus those costs and A$16-25m corporate. CAPEX phasing: FY27 A$453m (FY27 growth-capital guidance A$70-85m for KEP/TSF2 + ~A$250m MGGP pre-production + ~A$55m KGP sustaining/deferred stripping + ~A$70m capitalised exploration), FY28 A$418m (MGGP balance + A$59m UG), then A$170-185m/yr (sustaining both sites + exploration + A$105m 'other LOM' MGGP capital). TAX: 30% statutory; cash rate 22% FY27-28 while MGGP development and exploration are deducted as incurred, 26% FY29, 30% thereafter. The A$102.8m income tax payable at 30-Jun-2026 (FY26 expense A$122.6m, only A$18.7m paid) is deducted in the equity bridge because a rate-on-EBIT build would otherwise never collect it. TERMINAL: a mine is a depleting asset -- combined reserves 5.24Moz support ~13 years at the FY31 run-rate, so terminal growth is 0% and the cap multiple is 8x owner FCF (bull 10x with 1% growth on 8.7Moz of resources + 1.38Moz Golden Range; bear 6x). Owner FCF = reported FCF 169.503 - SBC 8.069 - interest income 16.055 = 145.379; interest stripped because net cash (A$505m) is 3.5x the FCF base. FY26 FCF is a TROUGH on capex (A$300.7m, of which ~A$230m growth) not on operations -- the 10-year component build, not a CAGR off that series, is the framing. Buybacks: none historically; flat count is a modelling convention the company has not paid for (SBC is only ~1% of revenue so the effect is small). Final FY26 dividend 5cps (~A$22.8m) is paid from the A$504.8m cash to current holders; no adjustment. Balance date 30-Jun-2026; price 22-Sep-2026 -- ~12 weeks of Q1 FY27 cash generation (~A$80-100m at spot) is not in the bridge, deliberately conservative.

equity_bridge.item: Income tax payable at 30 June 2026 (FY26 current tax not yet paid; cash tax FY26 A$18.7m vs expense A$122.6m)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY26-FY31 revenue CAGR from the ounce ramp (KGP 150k + MGGP to 255k) at a reverting gold price; no historical CAGR is usable as a forward proxy -- see notes
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (55-77%) diverges >30% from revenue (25-30%) and owner-FCF (10-14%) CAGRs. Equity growth is dominated by non-earned capital: A$200m placement Nov-2024, A$142m hedge-closure share issue Mar-2025, A$325m Warriedar scrip Nov-2025, plus the A$40.6m hedge-reserve swing. Not a compounding-of-book signal.
historical_growth.notes: Operating history is FY22-FY26 only (first gold June 2021); 5-year CAGRs would start from a pre-production FY21 and are meaningless, so 4-year (FY22->FY26) and 3-year (FY23->FY26) are reported. Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income, A$m): FY22 97.4, FY23 98.7, FY24 81.8, FY25 143.6, FY26 145.4. Owner-FCF CAGR (10.5%) is below reported-FCF CAGR (13.5%) because interest income on the growing cash pile (A$0.03m -> A$16.1m) is an increasing share of reported FCF; SBC is a steady ~1% of revenue. Revenue CAGR is ~90% gold price (A$2,471 -> A$6,241/oz) and ~10% ounces (116k -> 123k sold); EPS 3-year CAGR is not reported because FY23 EPS (A$0.012) carries the A$125m gold-forward restructure loss. FY26 reported FCF (A$169.5m) is depressed by A$300.7m capex, ~A$230m of it growth (KEP, MGGP early works, capitalised exploration); underlying OCF was A$470.2m.

bull.price_path_note: A$/oz 6,300 then 6,200 flat (spot sustained); oz sold (k) 145 / 222 / 335 / 385 / 475 / 510 / 510 / 505 / 445 / 435 incl. Golden Range Stage 2 60->90k from FY31 (A$250m capex FY29-30)

scenario_narratives.base: Gold reverts but stays well above reserve pricing: A$5,900/oz FY27 (spot ~A$6,130 today) sliding to A$4,800 by FY30 and holding nominal -- about 22% below spot, still 85% above the A$2,600 reserve price. KEP lifts Karlawinda to 150koz from FY28 at an EBITDA cash cost of ~A$2,600/oz (FY27 AISC guidance A$1,900-2,100 plus the ~A$700/oz of cost-of-sales items AISC defers). Mt Gibson starts site works Q2 FY27 and pours first gold Q3 FY28, ramping 60/170/225/255koz to ~260koz steady state by FY32, roughly one quarter behind the company's chart, at ~PFS costs (A$1,800-2,000/oz). Combined output ~405-410koz FY31-FY33, easing to ~330k as the Orion South underground finishes. Golden Range Stage 2 excluded. Owner FCF is heavily negative-to-thin in FY27-FY28 while ~A$870m of growth capital is spent from cash, then A$450-600m/yr. Terminal capped at 8x with zero growth: the asset depletes.
scenario_narratives.bull: Gold holds A$6,200/oz -- the FY26 realised price sustained -- through the horizon. Both builds execute on the company's own schedule: MGGP 70/180/230/260koz FY28-31, KGP nudges to 155koz on reserve growth (KGP reserve rose 32% to 1.57Moz in FY26). Golden Range Stage 2 (Warriedar's 1.38Moz) gets a PFS/FID in CY27 and adds 60-90koz from FY31 for ~A$250m, taking the group to ~500koz (the Range 500 aspiration). Costs as base. Terminal 10x with 1% growth reflecting 8.7Moz of resources beyond the 5.2Moz reserve.
scenario_narratives.bear: Gold mean-reverts: A$5,600 FY27, A$4,600 FY28, A$3,800 from FY29 (roughly the 5-year average) and stays there. WA EPA Part 4 approval for MGGP slips, pushing first gold to FY29 and adding 25% to the A$474m pre-production estimate (A$592m). Karlawinda underdelivers at 140koz with cash costs +6% (deeper Bibra pit, strip 7.7:1). At A$3,800 KGP's EBITDA margin compresses to ~25-30% and MGGP earns ~A$1,700/oz on a A$2,100 cost base; owner FCF is negative through FY29 and the A$505m cash pile is largely consumed by the build. Terminal 6x with zero growth. Not a solvency case -- the company is unhedged and ungeared -- but a 'paid A$7bn for a A$3,800 gold world' case.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear lifted to 30% from the 15% house default because the single dominant axis -- the AUD gold price -- is at an all-time high (~2x its 5-year average) and even the base case already assumes a 22% decline; a reversion toward A$3,800 is a normal cycle, not a tail. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to hold at once: record gold sustained for a decade, two mine builds on schedule, and a Golden Range Stage 2 that does not yet have a PFS. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Capricorn is a low-cost, ungeared, unhedged WA gold producer about to triple output (KEP to 150koz now; Mt Gibson 260koz from FY31) funded entirely from A$505m cash and Karlawinda cash flow. The valuation question is not execution -- the KGP build came in on time and Mt Gibson is permitted federally with a 14-month PFS payback -- it is what gold price to capitalise 400koz/yr at. The house answer is a reverting price (A$4,800 base) with a depleting-asset terminal (8x, 0% growth), which values the business well below a spot-price DCF; the bull case shows what the market is paying for.
key_risks_to_valuation: AUD gold price: every A$500/oz is ~A$200m/yr of EBITDA at 400koz; spot is ~2x the 5-year average and the company is fully unhedged
MGGP timing: WA EPA Part 4 / Works Approval still outstanding; PFS accuracy +/-25% on A$345m plant capex; first gold Q3 FY28 assumed
Karlawinda cost creep: AISC guided up 17-29% to A$1,900-2,100/oz in FY27 (strip 7.7:1, deeper Bibra pit)
Depletion: 10-year KGP reserve life and 19-year MGGP life; terminal value assumes reserves are replaced only at the cap-multiple level
Underground contribution (14% of MGGP LOM ounces, years 3-6) rests on a maiden 365koz UG reserve 'still in its infancy'
Capital allocation: Range 500 / Golden Range Stage 2 could redirect FCF into a third plant before MGGP is derisked
